title: M6 Production Runtime Check
summary: Production runtime is not ready; server, domain, database, or private-file storage configuration is still missing.

checks.title: Production database URL
checks.detail: DATABASE_URL must point at the production PostgreSQL instance, not localhost, 127.0.0.1, or procurex_local_only.

checks.title: Private file storage path or mount
checks.detail: PRIVATE_FILE_DIR must be a production private-file mount or object-storage service path.

checks.title: Public HTTPS API base URL
checks.detail: PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL must be a real HTTPS domain and must not use example.com.

checks.title: Production Node environment
checks.detail: NODE_ENV should be production for launch rehearsal and production runtime evidence.

checks.title: API process binding
checks.detail: HOST and PORT are configured for the API process.

requiredOperations: Provision production PostgreSQL and set DATABASE_URL.
Provision private payment-evidence storage and set PRIVATE_FILE_DIR.
Configure HTTPS domain and set PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL.
Run API and worker with NODE_ENV=production.
Run npm run db:migrate from one controlled shell before smoke validation.
